html:
core/locale/reader-content.ts

Keeps the reader-content <article> in sync with SPA
Sourcesrc/core/locale/reader-content.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

cache

Extracted article inner markup per path — pages rarely exceed ~30 KB.

holder

The hoisted

element (may hold stale content between navs).

generation

Monotonic counter so a slow earlier fetch never overwrites a newer one.

ensureHolder

Locates or creates the offscreen article holder. Emitted pages hoist theirs via main.ts; when none exists (first paint on a non-emitted route) an empty one is appended so later navigations can fill it.

updateReaderContent

Replaces the reader article's markup with the prerendered article of path's static page. Responses are cached per path; fetches race safely via the generation counter. A page without a reader article clears the holder (reader mode then correctly finds nothing to offer).

  • @param path URL path to mirror (e.g. window.location.pathname).
